preserved: Existing official and candidate central-supercontinent coastline and protected geography
8 peripheral mainland polygon shapes from V2.25 first pass
39 nearshore island candidates and 5 shape-only coast labels

limitations: No real or synthetic calibrated digital elevation model used; river flow direction, catchment size, or gradients not physically established.
Finite polyline and Bezier samples do not formally guarantee all continuum positions lie on land, nor test whether coastline morphology is geologically plausible.
Four render paths changed from source candidate route geometry: V2.24 model stays unchanged and is a historical source, not the exact V2.25 fourth-pass drawing.
Mouth sites are cartographic outlets determined by proximity to coast and containment, not measured estuaries or deltas.
Browser rendering still needs user visual inspection at full zoom and phone viewport.
units: SVG source-local cartographic units; not distance, real area, or planet projection
